setup.title: Seetlu — kit setup
setup.discover.none: No camera found on the network
setup.saved: Saved. Frigate restarts with the new configuration.
setup.zones: Zones (door, counter) are drawn in the installer app on the uploaded picture.
setup.recorder.help: Pick the brand, enter the recorder address and login, then scan its cameras. The kit only reads the sub stream; it never changes recorder settings.
setup.scan.none: No camera answers. Check the address, login and brand.
setup.taken: This camera is already used for the other role.
setup.verdict.low_fps: Stream OK, but under 5 frames per second: set the sub stream to 5–8 fps on the recorder.
setup.verdict.unreachable: Cannot read the stream. Check the address, login and channel.
setup.verdict.bad_codec: Codec not supported: set the sub stream to H.264 or H.265 on the recorder.
setup.verdict.too_small: Picture too small: set the sub stream to 640×360 or more (D1 704×576 is fine) on the recorder.
